title: OL Trey Pipkins agrees to return to Chargers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: OL Trey Pipkins agrees to return to Chargers
sources.description: The Chargers are re-signing veteran offensive lineman Trey Pipkins to a two-year, $10 million deal, Tom Pelissero of NFL Media.
